name: The First, Second and Third (Layered Reality)

system.description: Also at 6th level, you learn that you can layer Genjutsu on top of each other, merging them into a single casting. When you cast a Genjutsu of D-Rank or lower that targets a single creature and requires a saving throw, you can spend 1 or 2 Actualization Die. You can select additional Genjutsu of the same rank that does not deal damage, equal to the number of Actualization Die spent, merging them together. When you cast the triggering jutsu, you increase its Chakra cost by the base cost of the additionally chosen Genjutsu. If the target fails the saving throw of the triggering Genjutsu, they also suffer the effects of the merged Genjutsu. The rank of Jutsu this works with increases to C-Rank at 14th level.
